outcome_value.missing_reason: No numeric coverage value reported in supplied evidence.

qualitative_outcome.value: Strong eGFP staining was observed in virtually all hepatocytes; injected liver tissue had extremely high GFP-positive coverage and uninjected mice had very low background.
eGFP transcripts were abundant in mRNA-injected livers versus negligible background (average 1 count) in uninjected mice; Mann-Whitney p=0.0079.

endpoint.value: liver eGFP fluorescent signal above background

outcome_unit.value: fold above background (lower bound of reported range)

qualitative_outcome.value: Liver fluorescence was 3- to 4-fold above background and attenuated 2-fold relative to healthy controls.
Mean tumor fluorescence was not significantly different from liver fluorescence (97.1 × 10^6 photons/s/cm2/sr; Mann-Whitney p=0.8738).

endpoint.value: eGFP fluorescence in tumor versus non-tumor liver

comparator.value: non-tumor liver tissue from the same animals

qualitative_outcome.value: Fluorescence was broadly comparable between tumors and non-tumor liver, with no significant difference (Wilcoxon matched-pairs signed-rank p=0.5469; n=8).

endpoint.value: GFP staining in HuH-7-derived tumors versus adjacent liver

qualitative_outcome.value: Clear GFP staining was present in HuH-7-derived tumors, with higher-intensity staining in adjacent liver tissue.

unresolved_items: The supplied evidence reports contradictory directionality for xenograft western-blot comparison: one passage says liver signal was higher than tumor, whereas another says lower signal in liver than tumor (GP-002-E-aae35f6441d3ff3b and GP-002-E-53d9ffb107aa82ae).
The exact post-dose timepoint for the spontaneous Mdr2−/− HCC fluorescence experiment is not directly stated in the supplied evidence.
Some results describe liver-level expression only; these were not assigned to hepatocytes unless hepatocyte-specific evidence was directly provided.
